title: PERMACULTURE DESIGN AND THEORY: CERTIFICATE COURSE
rpt_for_credit: This course is repeatable for 8 credits
description: Permaculture design course meets internationally recognized standards for certification. Lectures, hands-on activities, experiential learning, group discussions, readings, student projects and presentations. Two mandatory weekend days. Design intensive, utilizing graphic and verbal presentation skills. Research into other functioning permaculture systems through literature, websites, and as observed on field trips.
clssnotes:
Permaculture Institute of North America certifies course completion. Meets international standards.
